target_pattern: Use subjunctive after cuando, en cuanto, and una vez que for future-dependent or command contexts; use indicative for habitual routines; use subjunctive after antes de que; and use imperfect subjunctive in past-time dependent narration.

cognitive_shift.english_trap: Using present indicative after when/as soon as/once in all contexts.
cognitive_shift.spanish_logic: Spanish separates routine facts from pending dependent actions by mood. Pending future or command-linked actions trigger subjunctive, while habitual repeated actions use indicative.
target_pattern_formula: future or command dependence: main clause plus cuando/en cuanto/una vez que plus subjunctive
habitual routine: main clause plus cuando/en cuanto/una vez que plus indicative
antes de que always takes subjunctive
past narration with dependency often uses imperfect subjunctive in the time clause
natural_examples: En cuanto reciba tu mensaje, te llamo.
Siempre ceno cuando termino de trabajar.
Limpio la cocina antes de que lleguen los invitados.

pattern_mutation.instructions: Transform each base sentence as instructed.
drills: Base: Te llamo cuando termine. -> change connector to en cuanto.
Base: Te llamo en cuanto termine. -> change connector to una vez que.
Base: Cenaremos cuando llegue Ana. -> change to command with avisame.
Base: Avisame cuando tengas tiempo. -> change to plural avisenme.
Base: Empezaremos cuando llegue el jefe. -> change to first person singular future.
Base: Siempre cenamos cuando termina el trabajo. -> change subject to yo.
Base: Suelo descansar cuando termino de trabajar. -> change verb descansar to leer.
Base: Limpio la casa antes de que llegue Juan. -> change subject of second clause to plural.
Base: Antes de que firmes, lee todo. -> change command to plural lean.
Base: Te avise cuando llegue. -> change to past narration with imperfect subjunctive in both clauses.
Base: Le dije que me llamara cuando saliera. -> change pronoun to nos.
Base: En cuanto reciba la confirmacion, reservare. -> change main clause to present command reserva.
Base: Siempre salimos cuando deja de llover. -> change to future-dependent event.
Base: Nos iremos cuando deje de llover. -> change to habitual routine.
Base: Te escribo cuando tenga noticias. -> make it habitual with siempre and adjust mood.

common_errors.mistake: Indicative used after cuando for future-dependent action
common_errors.why_it_happens: Direct transfer from English tense habits.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use present subjunctive when action is pending and required first.

common_errors.mistake: Subjunctive used in habitual time clauses
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use indicative for habitual repeated actions.

common_errors.mistake: Indicative after en cuanto in commands
common_errors.why_it_happens: Connector translated literally without mood logic.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Imperative plus en cuanto usually requires subjunctive in subordinate clause.
Antes de que always takes subjunctive.

common_errors.mistake: Present form kept in past narrative dependency
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use imperfect subjunctive when past trigger requires it.

common_errors.mistake: Infinitive used after cuando with different subject
common_errors.why_it_happens: Confusion with antes de plus infinitive structures.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use a finite conjugated verb with correct mood.
Check if context is habitual or pending dependent.

common_errors.mistake: Present subjunctive used after past command
common_errors.correct_spanish: Past main clause often requires imperfect subjunctive.

common_errors.mistake: Dropping que in una vez que
common_errors.correct_spanish: Keep full expression una vez que.

common_errors.mistake: Future indicative used inside subordinate time clause
common_errors.why_it_happens: Trying to mark future directly in both clauses.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use subjunctive in subordinate clause not future indicative.
